//go:build postingedgebench

package postingedge

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strconv"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/weaviate/weaviate/adapters/repos/db/lsmkv"
	"github.com/weaviate/weaviate/adapters/repos/db/vector/hnsw/distancer"
	"github.com/weaviate/weaviate/entities/cyclemanager"
	ent "github.com/weaviate/weaviate/entities/vectorindex/postingedge"
)

// TestMeasurePendingBudgetArm grows the index of TestMeasurePendingBudget once,
// with the absolute budget PE_BUDGET (bytes; negative for none), and writes
// what it wrote and how long it took to PE_OUT: one arm of the pre-registered
// comparison of 64 MB against 128 MB (bench-report.md of
// feat/posting-edge-index, e91ea884e4). PE_N (60 000) and PE_DIMS (768) as
// there.
func TestMeasurePendingBudgetArm(t *testing.T) {
	n, dims := armEnv("PE_N", 60000), armEnv("PE_DIMS", 768)
	budget, err := strconv.ParseInt(os.Getenv("PE_BUDGET"), 10, 64)
	require.NoError(t, err, "PE_BUDGET")
	vectors := latentVectors(n, dims, 9101)
	root := t.TempDir()
	noop := cyclemanager.NewCallbackGroupNoop()
	store, err := lsmkv.New(filepath.Join(root, "lsm"), root, testLogger(), nil, nil, noop, noop, noop)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	defer func() { require.NoError(t, store.Shutdown(context.Background())) }()
	cfg := PersistentConfig{
		ID: "vectors_measure", ShardName: "shard", ClassName: "Class", RootPath: root,
		Logger: testLogger(), DistanceProvider: distancer.NewCosineDistanceProvider(),
		noBackground: true, pendingBudget: budget,
	}
	index, err := Open(cfg, ent.NewDefaultUserConfig(), store)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	defer func() { require.NoError(t, index.Shutdown(context.Background())) }()
	ctx := context.Background()
	start := time.Now()
	const batch = 100
	for from := 0; from < n; from += batch {
		to := min(from+batch, n)
		require.NoError(t, index.AddBatch(ctx, sequentialIDs(to-from, uint64(from)), vectors[from:to]))
	}
	require.NoError(t, index.Settle(ctx))
	seconds := time.Since(start).Seconds()
	index.mu.RLock()
	g := index.g
	s := g.stats
	inserts := n - int(DefaultBaseSize)
	out := map[string]any{
		"n": n, "dims": dims, "budget": budget, "seconds": seconds, "inserts": inserts,
		"livePostings": livePostings(g), "postings": g.meta.Postings,
		"rowWrites": s.RowWrites, "rowWritesFull": s.RowWritesFull, "rowWritesSplit": s.RowWritesSplit,
		"rowWritesBudget": s.RowWritesBudget, "rowDists": s.RowDists, "pendingLog": s.PendingLog,
		"pendingHeapAtEnd": g.pendingHeap(),
		"rowBytesPerInsert": float64(s.RowWrites.Bytes) / float64(inserts),
	}
	index.mu.RUnlock()
	t.Logf("budget %d: %.1f s, rows %.0f B an insert, %d rows by the budget", budget, seconds,
		out["rowBytesPerInsert"], out["rowWritesBudget"])
	if path := os.Getenv("PE_OUT"); path != "" {
		raw, err := json.MarshalIndent(out, "", "  ")
		require.NoError(t, err)
		require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(path, raw, 0o644))
	}
}

func armEnv(name string, def int) int {
	if s := os.Getenv(name); s != "" {
		if v, err := strconv.Atoi(s); err == nil {
			return v
		}
	}
	return def
}
